_doc: Art data for the Launch Day renderer (src/ui/launch-render). Presentation only, never read by the sim. Units: metres, y up from the base plane (exit plane of the lowest nozzle). Part y = bottom of the part's structure; engines hang below it by engines.bellLen. Boosters at x != 0 (side view); depth -1 = behind the core (drawn darker, partly hidden). Payload parts (craft.onStack) are relative to vehicle.payloadTop. See src/ui/launch-render/README.md §5.2. Parts may define segs: [{len,d,dTop,mat,tint,nose,shape,lattice,vents,tiles,cells,band,segments,ribs,soot}] bottom→top (interstages and booster nose cones are segments of the stage that carries them, so they fall with it). Optional decoration: soot, frost, frostZones [[y0,y1] m from part base], raceway, gridFins (true|"fixed"), legs, legLen, fins, strakes, canards, flaps, tiles, skew (Soyuz boosters lean on the core), depth (1 = in front of the core), marks [{type: text|flag|band|stripe|logo|window|patch, y (m from part base), h, s (−1..1 across), text, color, vertical, size, country, logo}].
